properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 23 at 12:05PM MST until November 23 at 6:00PM MST by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow above 9000 feet. Snow accumulations between 3 and 7
inches. Brief heavy snowfall rates could lead to localized higher
accumulations.

* WHERE...Northwest San Juan Mountains and Southwest San Juan
Mountains.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM MST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Monday evening commute. Roads, and
especially bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and
hazardous.
properties.areaDesc: Northwestern San Juan Mountains; Southwest San Juan Mountains

properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 23 at 12:05PM MST until November 23 at 8:00PM MST by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Snow accumulations 2 to 6 inches.

* WHERE...La Garita Mountains Above 10000 Feet and Eastern San Juan
Mountains Above 10000 Feet.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM MST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Be prepared for winter driving conditions. Slow down and
use caution while traveling.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Heavy bands of snow will develop across the
southwest mountains through the afternoon. Quick bursts of moderate
to heavy snow can be expected, leading to near white out
conditions, quick snow accumulations and dangerous travel
conditions through the evening.
properties.areaDesc: La Garita Mountains Above 10000 Ft; Eastern San Juan Mountains Above 10000 Ft

properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 23 at 12:05PM MST until November 23 at 11:00PM MST by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations 1 to 3 inches.

* WHERE...The southern I-25 Corridor including Walsenburg and
Trinidad.

* WHEN...From 5 PM this afternoon to 11 PM MST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Be prepared for winter driving conditions. Slow down and
use caution while traveling.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Heavy bands of snow will develop across the
southeast mountains and into the southern I-25 Corridor through the
late afternoon and evening. Quick bursts of moderate to heavy snow
can be expected, leading to near white out conditions, quick snow
accumulations and dangerous travel conditions through the evening.
